title: helwingia japonica subsp. formosana
intro: Helwingia japonica subsp. formosana, commonly known as Taiwan yew plum or Formosan helwingia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Helwingiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Helwingia japonica subsp. formosana include anti-cancer, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties, as well as its ability to regulate blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
